mapper.insert: insert into learning_follow (user_id, follow_user_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{followUserId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from learning_follow where user_id = #{userId} and follow_user_id = #{followUserId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_follow where follow_user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from learning_follow where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'

select f.follow_id, f.user_id, f.follow_user_id, f.create_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.follow_user_id) as user_name, (select u.avatar from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.follow_user_id) as avatar from learning_follow f where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc, f.follow_id desc

select f.follow_id, f.user_id, f.follow_user_id, f.create_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.user_id) as user_name, (select u.avatar from sys_user u where u.user_id = f.user_id) as avatar from learning_follow f where f.follow_user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc, f.follow_id desc
